key_obligations: Merger Sub shall be merged with and into the Company
Company shall file with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware a certificate of merger
each share of Company Common Stock... shall be converted into the right to receive $95.00 in cash
Parent shall deposit with the Paying Agent an amount of cash necessary to pay the aggregate amount of Merger Consideration
Company shall provide prompt written notice to Parent of any demands received by the Company for appraisal
Prior to the Effective Time, the Company shall not, without the prior written consent of Parent, make any payment related to, or settle or offer to settle, any such demands
As of the Effective Time, each Company Option... shall be converted into a stock option... relating to the number of shares of Parent Common Stock
As of the Effective Time, each Company PSU... shall be converted into a restricted stock unit... relating to the number of shares of Parent Common Stock
As of the Effective Time, each Company RSA... shall be converted into a restricted share... relating to the number of shares of Parent Common Stock
As of the Effective Time, each Company Director RSA... shall be canceled and converted into the right to receive the Merger Consideration
As of the Effective Time, each Company RSU... shall be converted into a restricted stock unit... relating to the number of shares of Parent Common Stock
As of the Effective Time, each Company PCU... shall be converted into a phantom cash unit... relating to the number of shares of Parent Common Stock
the Company shall take all actions as may be reasonably required to provide that... no further Offering Period shall commence pursuant to the Company ESPP after the date hereof
Immediately prior to and effective as of the Effective Time... the Company shall terminate the Company ESPP
the Company shall conduct its business in all material respects in the Ordinary Course of Business consistent with past practice
the Company shall use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy the conditions specified in Section 6.3
No Company Solicitation. The Company shall not, and shall not authorize or permit any Person acting on its behalf to, directly or indirectly solicit any Offer or proposal
The Company shall furnish to Parent copies of all notices received by the Company regarding any pending or threatened Action
The Company shall afford Parent and its representatives access during normal business hours to inspect its properties and books

key_provisions: Certifies ownership of fully paid and non-assessable shares of Class A Common Stock with a par value of one cent ($0.01) each.
Shares are transferable only upon the books of the Company by the holder in person or by a duly authorized attorney upon surrender of this Certificate properly endorsed or assigned.

The Certificate and shares are issued under and subject to the laws of the State of Delaware and the provisions of the Second Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation and the Amended and Restated Bylaws.
Certificate is not valid until countersigned and registered by the Transfer Agent and Registrar.
The Company is authorized to issue more than one class or series of stock and will furnish statements of powers and preferences upon request.
